body.purpose: Locally hosted Manrope; dense component copy uses 12–13px.

motion.name: poster-hover
motion.purpose: Subtle 1.025 image scale; disabled for reduced motion.

decluttering.dashboard: Cleanup and storage first; connections and activity in native closed disclosures.
decluttering.compactSettings: One labelled native select with section optgroups at widths up to 900px.
decluttering.shell: Current route and deletion mode; no duplicate shortcuts or slogans.
decluttering.artwork: Decorative anime motifs remain in theme previews only.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: Operational action with visible hover and keyboard focus.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { font-family: "Manrope Variable", sans-serif; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.5; font-weight: 650; min-height: 39px; padding: 9px 13px; border: 1px solid var(--accent, #b0ed83); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--accent, #b0ed83); color: var(--accent-text, #162016); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-button-primary:hover { filter: brightness(0.95); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #b0ed83); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary button
components.description: Operational action with visible hover and keyboard focus.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { font-family: "Manrope Variable", sans-serif; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.5; font-weight: 650; min-height: 39px; padding: 9px 13px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #30343a); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--surface, #191b1e); color: var(--text, #f0f1f3); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { background: var(--raised, #24272b); color: var(--text, #f0f1f3); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #b0ed83); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Quiet button
components.description: Operational action with visible hover and keyboard focus.
components.css: .ds-button-quiet { font-family: "Manrope Variable", sans-serif; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.5; font-weight: 650; min-height: 39px; padding: 9px 13px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--muted, #a6abb4); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-button-quiet:hover { background: var(--raised, #24272b); color: var(--text, #f0f1f3); } .ds-button-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #b0ed83); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text field
components.description: Explicit label above a surface-toned field.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; font: 13px "Manrope Variable", sans-serif; color: var(--text, #f0f1f3); } .ds-field input { font: inherit; min-height: 40px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #30343a); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--surface, #191b1e); color: inherit; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: var(--muted, #a6abb4); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #b0ed83); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Active navigation item
components.description: Neutral selected surface with an accent icon and current-page semantics.
components.html: <nav aria-label="Main navigation"><button class="ds-nav" aria-current="page"><svg width="19" height="19" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="3" y="3" width="7" height="7" rx="1"/><rect x="14" y="3" width="7" height="7" rx="1"/><rect x="3" y="14" width="7" height="7" rx="1"/><rect x="14" y="14" width="7" height="7" rx="1"/></svg>Dashboard</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 11px; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 12px; font: 550 12px "Manrope Variable", sans-serif; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--raised, #24272b); color: var(--text, #f0f1f3); cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav svg { color: var(--accent, #b0ed83); } .ds-nav:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-nav:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #b0ed83); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Dry-run badge
components.description: Textual status with restrained accent tint.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 5px; font: 11px/1.5 "Manrope Variable", sans-serif; color: var(--text, #f0f1f3); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #b0ed83) 12%, var(--surface, #191b1e)); }

components.name: Cleanup panel
components.description: Bordered working surface with a modest section heading.
components.html:
Your next cleanup

Review eligible titles and their exact plans.
components.css: .ds-panel { padding: 25px 27px; background: var(--surface, #191b1e); border: 1px solid var(--line, #30343a); border-radius: 14px; color: var(--text, #f0f1f3); font-family: "Manrope Variable", sans-serif; } .ds-panel h2 { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 650; margin: 0 0 20px; } .ds-panel p { color: var(--muted, #a6abb4); font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.7; }

components.name: Secondary queue actions
components.description: Native disclosure keeps less frequent candidate actions available.
components.css: .ds-more { color: var(--muted, #a6abb4); font: 11px "Manrope Variable", sans-serif; } .ds-more summary { cursor: pointer; padding: 10px; border-radius: 7px; } .ds-more summary:hover { background: var(--raised, #24272b); color: var(--text, #f0f1f3); } .ds-more summary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #b0ed83); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-more > div { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line, #30343a); padding-top: 7px; margin-top: 4px; } .ds-more button { background: transparent; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; color: inherit; padding: 9px; text-align: left; font: inherit; cursor: pointer; } .ds-more button:hover { background: var(--raised, #24272b); } .ds-more button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #b0ed83); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-more .ds-reject { color: var(--red, #ffaaa5); }

narrative.overview: Neutral charcoal surfaces frame the real media library. Cleanup review and storage context lead, with restrained accent, tonal depth, and a sticky translucent header. Product truth and safety behavior remain owned by the existing application.
keyCharacteristics: Responsive navigation with persistent mode context

rules.name: Independent destructive meaning
rules.body: Keep destructive colors and explicit labels independent of the selected accent.

rules.name: Tonal depth
rules.body: Use tonal surfaces and borders for ordinary panels; reserve shadows for dialogs and compact navigation.

dos: Do retain all three anime presets and administrator accent choices.
Do preserve focus, labelled controls, native disclosures, reduced motion, and exact-plan review.
Do distinguish logical estimates from actual reclaimed storage.
donts: Don't invent metrics, media, or guaranteed storage savings.
Don't weaken dry-run/live visibility or protected confirmation flows.
Don't generalize the task-specific Taste annotation into a global preference.
